papers.title_zh: 肺结节的分类、生物标志物、信号通路、疾病谱、早期诊断与管理：风险适配管理框架的综合性综述
papers.title_en: Pulmonary nodules: classification, biomarkers, signaling pathways, diseases, early diagnosis and management.
papers.authors: Ye Z, Li L, Zhang M, Su W, Li X, Anwaar S, Xiang M, Yin Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Clinical Research Center (CRC), Medical Pathology Center (MPC), Cancer Early Detection and Treatment Center (CEDTC), Tra…
papers.authors_conclusion: Overall, care for pulmonary nodules should be risk-adapted, longitudinal, multidisciplinary, and patient-centered.
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告系统检索策略、纳入排除标准、偏倚评估或定量合成，属叙述性综述；结论多为框架性建议，不能提供诊断准确性或管理获益的效应量。对生物标志物与AI的定位较谨慎，强调其应作为影像和临床风险评估的辅助而非独立诊断，但缺乏可核验证据分级。信息不足：检索方法与证据质量评价未报告。
papers.reason: 为肺结节风险分层、随访策略、生物标志物与AI辅助诊断的定位提供综述性框架，影响结节门诊管理路径与后续研究设计时对证据等级的判断。
papers.abstract_en: Pulmonary nodules are increasingly detected by thoracic imaging and low-dose computed tomography-based lung cancer screening, but most are benign, transient, or indolent. Clinically, the key task is to distinguish nodules that require timely cancer-directed evaluation from those that can be safely observed. This review summarizes the classification, disease spectrum, risk assessment, early diagnosis, biomarkers, signaling mechanisms, translational models, and management of pulmonary nodules. We first distinguish imaging phenotypes and disease entities, then differentiate the individual-level models used to select candidates for lung cancer screening from the nodule-level models and structured reporting systems used after nodule detection. Low-dose computed tomography remains the foundation of screening and surveillance approaches, whereas magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), positron emission tomography combined with computed tomography, contrast-enhanced computed tomography, nonsurgical biopsy, surgical diagnosis, and local therapies play more selective roles depending on the probability of malignancy and patient fitness. Noninvasive biomarkers, including circulating cellular, nucleic acid, methylation, protein, autoantibody, extracellular vesicle, and metabolic analytes, are most likely to serve as adjuncts to imaging and clinical risk assessment rather than as stand-alone diagnostic tests. Artificial intelligence may support detection, workflow efficiency, malignancy risk reclassification, invasiveness assessment, and multimodal integration, but its value depends on external validation, calibration, implementation, and prospective evidence of management benefit. Mechanistic studies of adenocarcinoma spectrum subsolid nodules have implicated the involvement of early oncogenic signaling, genomic instability, immune escape, stromal and vascular remodeling, and adaptive survival pathways. Translational models can support mechanistic and procedural research, but do not replicate real-world nodule management in patients. Overall, care for pulmonary nodules should be risk-adapted, longitudinal, multidisciplinary, and patient-centered.

papers.title_zh: 不可切除III期NSCLC诱导期benmelstobart联合安罗替尼及化疗、序贯同步放化疗与免疫巩固对比标准同步放化疗后免疫巩固的随机对照II期试验方案（BEAM-LUNG）
papers.title_en: Efficacy and safety of induction benmelstobart plus anlotinib and chemotherapy followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy and benmelstobart consolidation versus concurrent chemoradiotherapy followed by benmelstobart consolidation in patients with unresectable stage III NSCLC: a randomized, controlled, multicenter phase II trial protocol (BEAM-LUNG).
papers.authors: Song Z, Ma S, Zhang X, Liu X
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Oncology, The Third Xiangya Hospital of Central South University, Changsha, China.
papers.ai_note: 本文为试验方案，无任何疗效或安全性数据，所有数值均为设计参数而非结果。需关注：1）试验组为诱导期三药联合（PD-L1抑制剂+抗血管TKI+化疗）叠加同步放化疗，多组分干预使阳性结果难以归因于单一机制；2）主要终点PFS自随机时点计算，包含诱导治疗期，诱导无效者的早期进展事件会稀释或扭曲组间差异解读；3）试验组放疗靶区基于诱导后残留病灶并包含初始受累淋巴结站，与对照组基于基线影像的靶区定义不一致，可能引入实施偏倚；4）摘要未说明盲法、诱导期疾病进展后的处理与交叉、以及放疗质控措施；5）II期152例、HR 0.55的假定较为乐观，若真实效应较小则检验效能不足。以上为方案层面的方法学疑点，非对结果的判断。

pico.p: 计划入组152例组织学或细胞学确诊、不可切除的III期NSCLC（UICC/AJCC第9版），无敏化驱动基因突变，ECOG PS 0-1；按PD-L1 TPS（<1% vs ≥1%）、分期（IIIA vs IIIB/IIIC）、组织学及中心分层
pico.ic: 试验组（A组）：2周期诱导benmelstobart（1200 mg d1 Q3W）+安罗替尼（8 mg d1-14）+含铂双药化疗，随后同步放化疗（放疗期间停用benmelstobart）及benmelstobart巩固至多1年；对照组（B组）：同步放化疗后benmelstobart巩固至多1年；放疗为累及野IMRT/VMAT 60 Gy/30次，或SIB 60-66 Gy至PGTV、54 Gy至PTV/30次

papers.reason: 为不可切除III期NSCLC提供“诱导化疗免疫+抗血管”前置整合的随机对照证据框架，其PFS结果将直接影响同步放化疗前是否加诱导治疗这一临床决策，并为后续III期设计与对照组基线提供参照；当前仅可作为在研究登记与方案设计参考。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The PACIFIC and GEMSTONE-301 trials established consolidation immunotherapy post-chemoradiotherapy for unresectable stage III NSCLC, but 22-30% of patients fail initial chemoradiotherapy, precluding consolidation. PACIFIC-2 and CheckMate 73L failures highlight the need for better integration. Induction chemoimmunotherapy before radiotherapy may improve downstaging and immune activation. This trial evaluates whether induction benmelstobart (PD-L1 inhibitor) plus anlotinib (TKI) and chemotherapy, followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy and benmelstobart consolidation, improves progression-free survival over standard concurrent chemoradiotherapy plus consolidation. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This prospective, randomized, controlled, multicenter phase II trial will enroll 152 patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed unresectable stage III NSCLC (per UICC/AJCC 9th edition), without sensitizing driver mutations, and ECOG performance status 0-1. Randomization is centralized and stratified by PD-L1 tumor proportion score (<1% vs ≥1%), disease stage (IIIA vs IIIB/IIIC), histology, and participating centre. Patients will be randomized 1:1 to either the experimental arm (Arm A): two cycles of induction benmelstobart (1200 mg, day 1, every 3 weeks) plus anlotinib (8 mg, days 1-14) and platinum-based doublet chemotherapy, followed by concurrent chemoradiotherapy (with benmelstobart withheld during radiotherapy) and benmelstobart consolidation for up to one year; or the control arm (Arm B): concurrent chemoradiotherapy followed by benmelstobart consolidation for up to one year. The primary endpoint is progression-free survival (PFS) measured from randomization. Radiotherapy consists of involved-field IMRT/VMAT to a standard prescription of 60 Gy in 30 fractions, or a simultaneous integrated boost delivering 60-66 Gy to the planning gross tumor volume and 54 Gy to the planning target volume in 30 fractions; in the experimental arm, target volumes are based on post-induction residual disease with inclusion of all initially involved nodal stations. Consolidation benmelstobart will continue for up to one year or until disease progression/unacceptable toxicity. The sample size provides 80% power (two-sided α = 0.05) to detect a PFS hazard ratio of 0.55. CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: https://clinicaltrials.gov/, identifier NCT07643350.

papers.title_zh: 合并用药与广泛期小细胞肺癌tarlatamab（双特异性T细胞衔接器）治疗结局的关联：倾向性匹配回顾性队列研究
papers.title_en: Concomitant medications and outcomes of bispecific T-cell engager therapy: A propensity-matched study of tarlatamab in ES-SCLC.
papers.authors: Eysha M, Green A, Khamis MM, Arai M, McKenzie B, Black M, Zaki IH, Zhang B et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Internal Medicine, Paul L.
papers.results: 主要终点OS：5类合并用药与显著更差OS相关——抗生素 HR 3.20（CI 2.12-4.84）、阿片类 HR 2.84（CI 1.71-4.70）、对乙酰氨基酚 HR 2.26（CI 1.23-4.14）、糖皮质激素 HR 2.14（CI 1.30-3.52）、苯二氮䓬类 HR 1.55（CI 1.06-2.27）。次要终点：无任何药物类别显著影响ICANS（未报告具体数值）；CRS未报告数值。
papers.authors_conclusion: 数种常用药物与接受tarlatamab治疗的ES-SCLC患者更差生存相关；尽管不能排除残余混杂，上述发现支持对BiTE治疗期间合并用药开展前瞻性研究。
papers.ai_note: 选择性呈现：主要终点OS仅给出阳性药物类别的HR，未给出各组中位OS/绝对生存率及阴性药物类别结果，10次比较未做多重性校正；次要终点CRS完全无数值，ICANS仅以“无显著影响”定性表述。暴露窗定义为治疗开始前或后3个月，纳入治疗后用药可致反向因果（疾病恶化后才用抗生素/阿片/激素）。抗生素、糖皮质激素、阿片类、对乙酰氨基酚、苯二氮䓬类均为疾病严重度与体能状态的可疑代理变量，倾向性匹配无法消除未测量混杂（ECOG、肿瘤负荷、住院状态）。数据时间窗标注至2026年5月，与回顾性数据库研究的常规时点不符，信息不足，无法核实。

pico.p: TriNetX数据库中2024年4月至2026年5月接受tarlatamab治疗的肺癌（ES-SCLC）患者；10组倾向性匹配比较，每臂112–229例，平均年龄65–68岁
pico.ic: 干预/暴露：治疗开始前或后3个月内使用特定合并用药类别（抗生素、阿片类、对乙酰氨基酚、糖皮质激素、苯二氮䓬类等）；对照：匹配后未暴露于该药物类别的tarlatamab治疗患者（匹配变量含人口学、合并症、疾病特征、既往治疗及其余九类用药）

papers.reason: 为ES-SCLC中tarlatamab（DLL3×CD3 BiTE）真实世界生存结局提供合并用药层面的效应量估计，提示在解读BiTE疗效与设计前瞻性试验/真实世界队列时需将抗生素、激素、阿片类等作为生存混杂因素分层或校正，而非直接推断为因果性不良影响。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Tarlatamab, a bispecific T-cell engager (BiTE), has shown efficacy in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC). However, the impact of concomitant medications on treatment outcomes remains unknown. We evaluated the association between commonly prescribed medications and survival and toxicities in patients receiving tarlatamab. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using TriNetX between April 2024 and May 2026. Lung cancer patients on tarlatamab were stratified according to exposure to concomitant medications within 3 months before or after treatment initiation. The primary endpoint was overall survival (OS), while secondary endpoints were cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS). One-to-one propensity score matching was performed for demographics, comorbidities, disease characteristics, prior therapies, and the remaining nine medication classes. RESULTS: Among ten propensity-matched comparisons, cohort sizes ranged from 112 to 229 per arm, with mean patient age from 65 to 68 years. Five medication classes were associated with significantly worse OS: antibiotics (HR 3.20, CI 2.12-4.84), opioids (HR 2.84, CI 1.71-4.70), acetaminophen (HR 2.26, CI 1.23-4.14), glucocorticosteroids (HR 2.14, CI 1.30-3.52), and benzodiazepines (HR 1.55, CI 1.06-2.27). No medication class significantly affected ICANS. CONCLUSIONS: Several commonly used medications were associated with inferior survival in patients receiving tarlatamab for ES-SCLC. Although residual confounding cannot be excluded, these findings support prospective investigation of concomitant medication use during BiTE therapy.

papers.title_zh: 既往肺外恶性肿瘤与肺癌根治性切除术后结局：多中心回顾性队列未显示独立生存劣势
papers.title_en: Prior Extrapulmonary Malignancy and Outcomes After Lung Cancer Resection.
papers.authors: Ishikawa Y, Shigeta N, Nemoto D, Yasuura Y, Aoyama T, Toyoda M, Kaburaki Y, Isaka T et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Yokosuka Kyosai Hospital, Yokosuka, Japan; ishikaway.ths@outlook.com.
papers.results: 未校正5年OS：PEM组80.43%，NPEM组81.42%（p=0.092）；5年RFS：68.76% vs 68.52%（p=0.983）；PEM与OS无独立关联（HR=1.046，95%CI=0.825-1.326，p=0.712），与RFS亦无独立关联（HR=0.970，95%CI=0.798-1.178，p=0.756）；IPTW校正分析结果一致；Fine-Gray模型示PEM与肺癌相关死亡及非肺癌死亡均无显著关联
papers.authors_conclusion: PEM未独立恶化肺癌切除术后的肿瘤控制或生存；根治性意向手术应依据当前肺癌的生物学行为与可手术性来决定，而非仅凭既往肿瘤史
papers.ai_note: 未校正5年OS的p=0.092处于边缘，摘要未给出绝对差值的95%CI，结论以“无独立关联”表述可能掩盖小幅绝对差异；PEM组更多为其他疾病监测中发现、更多接受限定切除，提示领先时间偏倚与手术方式混杂，虽行IPTW但摘要未列校正变量；既往肿瘤的类型、分期、确诊时间间隔及活动状态均未描述，暴露定义异质性大；Fine-Gray仅述“无显著关联”而未给sHR与CI，无法评估把握度；主要终点未明确预设，随访时长与失访信息不足；结论中“不应仅凭既往肿瘤史限制手术”属合理但需前瞻验证

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND/AIM: With the aging population, thoracic surgeons increasingly encounter patients with primary lung cancer who have a history of prior extrapulmonary malignancy (PEM). We investigated whether PEM independently compromises survival after curative-intent lung cancer resection and whether any difference is explained by impaired cancer control or competing mortality. PATIENTS AND METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 1,857 consecutive lung cancer resections performed in 2017-2018 at 12 Yokohama City University-affiliated institutions. After exclusion of 74 patients with prior lung cancer only, 1,783 patients remained: 505 in the PEM group and 1,278 in the no prior extrapulmonary malignancy (NPEM) group. Overall survival (OS), recurrence-free survival (RFS), inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW)-adjusted outcomes, and Fine-Gray competing-risk analyses were evaluated. RESULTS: Compared with the NPEM group, the PEM group was older and included higher proportions of men, ever-smokers, patients diagnosed during surveillance for other diseases, and patients treated with limited resection. Unadjusted 5-year OS was 80.43% in the PEM group and 81.42% in the NPEM group (p=0.092), whereas 5-year RFS was 68.76% and 68.52%, respectively (p=0.983). PEM was not independently associated with OS [hazard ratio (HR)=1.046, 95% confidence interval (CI)=0.825-1.326, p=0.712] or RFS (HR=0.970, 95%CI=0.798-1.178, p=0.756). IPTW-adjusted analyses were concordant. Fine-Gray models showed no significant association between PEM and lung cancer-related death or non-lung-cancer death. CONCLUSION: PEM did not independently worsen postoperative cancer control or survival after lung cancer resection. Curative-intent surgery should therefore be considered according to the biology and operability of the current lung cancer rather than prior cancer history alone.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Postoperative PD-1/PD-L1 blockade after complete resection of non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is mainly reported using relative disease-free survival (DFS) effects. We estimated absolute effects for distinct completed trial policies. METHODS: We systematically reviewed randomized phase III trials of postoperative single-agent PD-1/PD-L1 blockade. Published Kaplan-Meier curves were reconstructed to estimate trial-specific 36-month restricted mean DFS time (RMST) and DFS probability differences. Primary intervals used 2,000 arm-stratified bootstrap replicates. Sensitivity analyses examined reconstruction methods and time horizons; overall survival (OS) reconstruction was exploratory. Harms were described by trial, without pooling. REGISTRATION: PROSPERO CRD420261469971. RESULTS: Four trial families included 4,336 participants. Thirty-six-month RMST differences ranged from 1.34 to 1.97 months; DFS probability differences corresponded to 2.3-6.1 additional participants without a trial-defined DFS event per 100 randomized. Confidence intervals included zero for two RMST and three DFS probability estimates. The KEYNOTE-091 DFS probability interval crossed zero under alternative reconstruction; RMST interval interpretations were unchanged. The four-trial hazard-ratio synthesis was descriptive and model sensitive. Exploratory 36-month OS reconstructions in three trials yielded intervals allowing benefit and harm. In three trials with available between-arm safety data, severe and serious adverse events were more frequent with checkpoint blockade. CONCLUSIONS: Reconstructed trial-specific estimates suggest average absolute DFS gains through 36 months, with substantial uncertainty. They complement the original trial results when discussing postoperative treatment; they do not establish a class-wide effect, treatment ranking, or individual benefit.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION AND AIMS: Oral mucositis (OM) impairs quality of life, necessitates dose modification, and disrupts treatment continuity in patients receiving EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR-TKIs), yet comparative OM risks across monotherapies and combination regimens remain poorly defined. METHODS: PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched from inception to June 13, 2026, for phase II or III randomized controlled trials. Bayesian random-effects network meta-analyses estimated odds ratios (ORs) with 95% credible intervals (CrIs) for any-grade and grade ≥3 OM. Treatments were ranked using the surface under the cumulative ranking curve (SUCRA). RESULTS: Sixty-three trials involving 21,845 participants were included. Compared with chemotherapy, higher odds of any-grade OM were observed with afatinib plus cetuximab (OR 11.97, 95% CrI 2.27-65.45), afatinib (OR 9.73, 95% CrI 3.75-26.50), dacomitinib (OR 5.12, 95% CrI 1.71-16.00), and erlotinib plus chemotherapy (OR 2.84, 95% CrI 1.27-6.53), with low-, high-, moderate-, and very-low-certainty evidence, respectively; for grade ≥3 OM, with afatinib plus cetuximab (OR 13.91, 95% CrI 1.55-199.26), afatinib (OR 8.80, 95% CrI 1.37-100.11), and mobocertinib (OR 8.12, 95% CrI 1.14-97.77), all supported by moderate-certainty evidence. Afatinib plus cetuximab ranked highest for both outcomes (SUCRA, 89.0% and 91.6%). Second-generation EGFR-TKIs generally ranked higher, whereas the third-generation agents osimertinib and furmonertinib ranked lower. Combination regimens often yielded higher point estimates than matched monotherapies, but most comparisons were inconclusive. CONCLUSIONS: OM risk varies substantially across EGFR-TKI regimens. Higher-risk regimens warrant strengthened baseline oral assessment, patient education, and monitoring during treatment. Given limited head-to-head evidence for novel agents/combinations and imprecision in some estimates, findings warrant further validation in standardized prospective studies. SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261449930, identifier CRD420261449930.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Immunotherapy in combination with chemotherapy has been recommended as the first-line treatment of driver gene-negative advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but the efficacy is reduced in NSCLC patients with bone metastases due to the immunosuppressive microenvironment. Both nuclear factor kappa-B ligand (RANKL) inhibitors and stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) have been shown to modulate the tumour immune microenvironment. Therefore, narlumosbart, a monoclonal antibody targeting RANKL, in combination with SBRT, may exert synergistic effects and improve efficacy of first-line chemoimmunotherapy in this population. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This single-arm, single-centre phase II clinical trial will enrol driver gene-negative advanced NSCLC patients with bone metastases who have not received any systemic therapy. Eligible patients will receive narlumosbart (120 mg subcutaneously every 4 weeks) and SBRT to bone target lesions (24 Gy/3 fractions for spinal metastases and 30-35 Gy/5 fractions for non-spinal lesions), followed by standard first-line chemoimmunotherapy. The primary endpoint is the objective response rate of non-radiotherapy lesions. Secondary endpoints include safety and tolerability, progression-free survival, overall survival, bone-related events, pain score and quality of life. Sample size was calculated using the Simon's Two-Stage method (α=0.05, power=0.8, H₀=25%, H₁=50%). Nine patients will be enrolled in stage 1. If ≥2 patients achieve complete response (CR)/partial response (PR), an additional 15 patients will be enrolled in stage 2. If fewer than two patients achieve CR/PR, the trial will be terminated. 27 subjects will be enrolled in this project, considering the dropout rate of 10%. ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: This study was approved by the Medical Ethics Committee of Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center (approval number 2411308-15) on 6 December 2024. The trial registration number is NCT06738160 at clinicaltrials.gov, sponsored by Fudan University, and registered in December 2024 before the enrolment of the first participant in February 2025. The trial will be conducted in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and Good Clinical Practice guidelines. Written informed consent will be obtained from all participants prior to enrolment. Results will be published in a peer-reviewed journal.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Immune-checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) plus chemotherapy have demonstrated survival benefits in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (SCLC). The integration of immunotherapy with concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT) may improve survival outcomes in limited-stage SCLC (LS-SCLC). This phase II randomized controlled study was designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of toripalimab consolidation versus observation in patients with LS-SCLC after CCRT. METHODS: We conducted this phase II, randomized controlled trial in patients with LS-SCLC who had completed CCRT. Eligible patients were randomized 1:1 to either toripalimab consolidation (240 mg every 3 weeks for up to 6 months) or observation. Randomization was stratified according to disease stage (I or II vs III) and the receipt of prophylactic cranial irradiation (PCI) (yes vs no). The primary endpoint was progression-free survival (PFS). The secondary endpoints included overall survival (OS), objective response rate and toxicities. RESULTS: Between June 30, 2020, and May 31, 2024, a total of 98 patients were randomized to receive either toripalimab consolidation (n=49) or observation (n=49) after CCRT. The trial was prematurely terminated on May 31, 2024. Objective responses were observed in 14 of 23 patients (60.9%) in the toripalimab group and in 9 of 24 patients (37.5%) in the observation group. The median PFS was not reached in the toripalimab group, compared with 14.1 months (95% CI 2.8 to 25.4) in the observation group (HR, 0.55; 95% CI 0.31 to 0.96). The median OS was not reached with toripalimab, compared with 30.3 months (95% CI 20.4 to 40.2) with observation (HR, 0.39; 95% CI 0.19 to 0.80). Treatment-related toxicities were generally mild. Adverse events led to discontinuation of study drug in 6 of 48 patients (12.5%) in the toripalimab group. Grade 3 pneumonitis or radiation pneumonitis occurred in two patient (4.2%) in the toripalimab group and one patient (2.0%) in the observation group. No grade 4 or 5 adverse events occurred in either group. Subgroup analyses of PFS and OS favored toripalimab over observation across all predefined subgroups, including age, sex, Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status, smoking status, disease stage, response to CCRT and the receipt of PCI. CONCLUSION: Consolidative toripalimab showed promising signals of improved PFS and OS with a manageable safety profile in patients with LS-SCLC. These findings warrant confirmation in larger, adequately powered randomized trials.

papers.abstract_en: Primary and acquired resistance to targeted therapy represent significant challenges to durable treatment responses in oncology. In lung adenocarcinoma, KRAS inhibitors are hampered by incomplete clinical responses and acquired resistance. Here we treated genetically engineered mouse models of Kras-driven lung adenocarcinoma with KRAS inhibitors to model these conditions. Initial treatment response was rapid but incomplete, with residual tumor burden transcriptionally resembling alveolar epithelial cells. With continued treatment, we invariably observed genetic Kras amplification as a resistance mechanism. To model oncogene-independent resistance, we used functional CRISPR approaches to promote squamous lineage transformation. We found that ∆Np63 was sufficient to transform alveolar organoids to a squamous state in vitro, conferring insensitivity to KRAS inhibition. In vivo, Nkx2-1 loss and/or ectopic Sox2 expression poised tumors for squamous lineage commitment. Squamous-transformed tumors did not exhibit evidence of KRAS/MAPK reactivation, underscoring the role for lineage transcription factors and histologic transformation in mediating KRAS independence.

papers.abstract_en: Biomarkers used to guide immunotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) are invasive, variably available, and insufficient to capture clinical and regional heterogeneity, leaving many patients inadequately stratified for prognosis. We develop a clinical attribute-based framework that leverages routinely collected variables to estimate survival risk, even when baseline data are incomplete. We analyze 17 051 patients with NSCLC treated with immunotherapy, assembled from published cohorts and tertiary centers across multiple regions, and evaluate seventeen common clinical attributes using a two-stage survival modeling strategy with external validation in Western and East Asian populations. Clinical attributes exhibit context-dependent prognostic effects across variable-defined strata and survival endpoints, with performance status and disease stage emerging as the most consistent determinants of survival risk prediction, alongside region-specific modifiers. Here we show that this "start-anywhere" clinical risk matrix provides robust, population-aware prognostic stratification and complements biomarkers for assessing immunotherapy outcomes in patients with NSCLC.

papers.authors: Li J, Li C, Liu J, Wang C, Zhao Y, Ge A, Dong Y, Yang X et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Public Health, Jilin University, Changchun, China.
papers.results: 主要终点为≥2级放射性肺炎（RP），非RP相关死亡作为竞争风险。多因素Cox回归经Fine-Gray竞争风险分析验证，确定饮酒史、放疗方式、基线乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）、系统炎症评分（SIS）及急性放射性食管炎（RE）为独立因素（均P < 0.05）。三个序贯模型中整合模型（Model 3）C-index最高（0.688），6个月时间依赖AUC为0.713；与基线模型（Model 1）相比，Model 3改善风险重分类（连续NRI = 0.274，IDI = 0.037；均P < 0.05）。Model 3校准最佳，在DCA中于10%-15%阈值概率区间获得最高净临床获益。SHAP分析显示基线SIS = 0与更高RP风险存在潜在关联。
papers.authors_conclusion: 本研究开发并验证了一个整合基础临床因素、炎症指标（LDH和SIS）及早期急性放射性食管炎（RE）的列线图；该模型可作为肺癌患者放射性肺炎（RP）早期风险评估的多维辅助筛查工具。
papers.ai_note: 单中心回顾性设计，仅采用bootstrap内部验证，未见外部验证或前瞻验证，C-index 0.688/6月AUC 0.713判别力偏低，临床可用性受限；摘要未报告事件数、缺失数据处理与模型过拟合控制细节。DCA净获益仅在10%-15%的窄阈值区间最优，属选择性强调的有利区间。SIS = 0与更高RP风险相关的方向与“炎症负荷高则风险高”的常规预期相反，可能源于指标编码、共线性或分组切点不稳，需外部数据核实。摘要将主要终点定义为≥2级RP，但仅报告模型性能指标，未给出各亚组或总体RP发生率。

pico.p: 726例接受放疗的肺癌患者（回顾性收集）
pico.ic: 整合基础临床因素、基线LDH、系统炎症评分（SIS）与急性放射性食管炎（RE）的多维列线图模型（Model 3），与基线模型（Model 1）等序贯模型比较；无干预性对照

papers.reason: 为肺癌放疗患者放射性肺炎的早期风险分层提供可解释列线图框架与炎症-食管炎联合特征基线，可作为后续外部验证与前瞻干预性研究（如风险适应性随访/剂量限制）的对照参考；但当前判别力与验证层级不足以直接改变临床决策。
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate the value of systemic inflammatory prognostic markers and early clinical toxicity in the risk assessment of radiation pneumonitis (RP) after radiotherapy in lung cancer patients. We developed and validated an explainable, auxiliary nomogram integrating multiple features and SHAP analysis to optimize early risk monitoring and clinical decision-making. METHODS: A least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) penalized Cox model was used for feature selection to build a multivariable Cox proportional hazards model, which was visualized as a nomogram. A Fine-Gray competing risks model was used for sensitivity analysis. Model performance was evaluated using the C-index, 6-month time-dependent AUC, calibration, continuous NRI/IDI, and decision curve analysis (DCA). Internal validation using bootstrap resampling. Finally, SHAP analysis was performed to interpret the final Cox model through beeswarm and waterfall plots. RESULTS: This study retrospectively collected data on 726 patients with lung cancer who received radiotherapy. The primary endpoint was grade ≥2 RP, with non-RP-related death treated as a competing risk. Multivariable Cox regression, validated by Fine-Gray competing risk analysis, identified alcohol history, radiotherapy modality, baseline lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), systemic inflammation score (SIS), and acute radiation esophagitis (RE) as independent factors (all P < 0.05). Among the three sequential models, the integrated model (Model 3) achieved the highest C-index (0.688) and 6-month AUC (0.713). Compared to the baseline model (Model 1), Model 3 improved risk reclassification (continuous NRI = 0.274, IDI = 0.037; both P < 0.05). Model 3 demonstrated optimal calibration and yielded the highest net clinical benefit within the 10%-15% threshold probability range in DCA. Furthermore, SHAP analysis enhanced model interpretability, indicating a potential association between a baseline systemic inflammation score of zero (SIS = 0) and higher RP risk. CONCLUSION: This study developed and validated a nomogram that integrates fundamental clinical factors with inflammatory indicators (LDH and SIS) and early acute radiation esophagitis (RE). This model serves as a multidimensional, auxiliary screening tool for early risk assessment of radiation pneumonitis (RP) in lung cancer patients.

papers.title_zh: 不同固定方案显著影响非细胞块细胞学标本的免疫细胞化学染色质量：IASLC细胞学工作组七实验室研究
papers.title_en: Evaluating immunocytochemistry performance in lung cancer cytology: An IASLC Cytology Working Group study.
papers.authors: Jain D, Srebotnik-Kirbis I, Nambirajan A, Engels M, Kern I, Kim TJ, Lozano MD, Minami Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pathology, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi, Delhi, India.
papers.results: PreservCyt固定出现次优染色比例81.8%，空气干燥制片为58.8%；Delaunay固定、巴氏染色及甲醇固定聚乙二醇包被制片较其他评估的固定方案表现稳定优越。摘要未给出各标志物分项数值及统计检验结果
papers.authors_conclusion: 本研究显示固定方案显著影响非细胞块细胞学制片的ICC表现；所观察到的固定依赖性差异凸显了统一预分析实践、开展可靠本地验证及外部质量评估的必要性
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告任何统计学检验、置信区间或各标志物（TTF-1/p40/ALK/ROS1）分层结果，81.8%与58.8%的分母亦未交代，'consistently superior'仅为定性表述；四级评分判读存在主观性且未述及判读者间一致性；实验室选取基于63家机构探索性调查，代表性有限；染色强度与临床可判读性（如ALK/ROS1判读阈值）之间的关联未评估，故结论不宜外推为临床检测效能差异

pico.p: 7家代表常用细胞学固定方案的实验室（依据对63家机构的探索性全球调查选出）；共评估来自17轮研究运行的105张染色切片
pico.ic: 对已确认标志物表达的标本制备直接涂片、细胞离心涂片及PreservCyt保存细胞，按各实验室本地流程行TTF-1、p40、ALK、ROS1免疫细胞化学染色，经数字化后以标准化四级评分独立判读；比较不同固定方案间的染色表现

papers.reason: 提示细胞学标本固定方案可使ICC染色质量出现数量级差异，直接影响晚期NSCLC仅凭细胞学材料行分型与ALK/ROS1预测标志物检测时的标本可接受性判断与本地验证策略
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Immunohistochemistry (IHC) is essential for tumor subtyping and predictive biomarker analysis in non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC). When only cytological material is available and no concurrent biopsy or cell block exists, immunocytochemistry (ICC) may need to be performed on slides prepared using diverse fixation protocols, introducing substantial pre-analytical variability. METHODS: Seven laboratories representing commonly used cytology fixation protocols were selected based on an exploratory global survey of 63 institutions. Two central laboratories prepared direct smears, cytospins and provided cells in PreservCyt from specimens with confirmed marker expression using the selected fixation protocols. Materials were distributed for immunocytochemical demonstration of TTF-1, p40, ALK, and ROS1 according to local protocols. Digitized slides were independently evaluated using standardized four-tier scoring criteria. RESULT: A total of 105 stained slides from 17 study runs were assessed. Delaunay-fixed, Papanicolaou-stained, and methanol-fixed polyethylene glycol-coated preparations demonstrated consistently superior ICC performance compared with other evaluated fixation protocols. In contrast, high rates of suboptimal staining were observed with PreservCyt fixation (81.8%) and air-dried preparations (58.8%). CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates that fixation protocol significantly impacts ICC performance on non-cell block cytological preparations. The observed fixation-dependent differences underscore the need for harmonized pre-analytical practices, robust local validation, and external quality assessment.

papers.title_zh: KRAS突变肺腺癌中PRTN3通过蛋白水解灭活CXCL9驱动免疫抑制：一项临床前机制研究
papers.title_en: PRTN3 drives immunosuppression in KRAS-mutant lung adenocarcinoma through proteolytic inactivation of CXCL9.
papers.authors: Liu Y, Zhang C, Li J, Chen C, Xu S, Li T, Chen H, Hou Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Immunology, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences & School of Basic Medicine, Chinese Academy of Medical Sci…
papers.authors_conclusion: Our findings reveal a KRAS/c-Myc/PRTN3 axis that promotes immune suppression through extracellular proteolytic inactivation of CXCL9. Targeting PRTN3-mediated immune evasion may represent a promising strategy to enhance ICB efficacy in KRAS-driven LUAD.（中文口径：研究揭示了KRAS/c-Myc/PRTN3轴通过细胞外蛋白水解灭活CXCL9促进免疫抑制；靶向PRTN3介导的免疫逃逸可能是增强KRAS驱动LUAD中ICB疗效的有前景策略。）
papers.ai_note: 摘要无任何样本量、效应量、置信区间或P值，全部结果仅为定性描述，无法评估效应强度与可重复性；‘PRTN3高表达与细胞毒免疫签名降低、CXCL9活性下降相关’属相关性证据，不能支持因果；体内治疗证据来自PRTN3基因抑制而非药物学抑制，缺药代/毒性/给药数据；水解抗性CXCL9变体的功能恢复仅在患者来源类器官中验证，未在体内证实；ICB增效结论基于同系小鼠模型，向人KRAS突变LUAD（异质性、共突变谱）外推有限；结论段强调‘有前景的策略’，而缺乏任何临床或药物开发层面的定量支撑，存在乐观外推倾向。

pico.p: 人LUAD队列、基因工程小鼠模型、肿瘤细胞模型及患者来源类器官（摘要未给出样本量）
pico.ic: 干预：PRTN3基因抑制、水解抗性CXCL9变体；对照：未明确描述（体内联合抗PD-1治疗）

papers.reason: 为KRAS突变LUAD免疫耐药提供可干预的肿瘤内在靶点（PRTN3）及CXCL9/CXCR3效应轴假设，可作为免疫治疗转化队列的生物标志物分层依据与后续药物开发立项的机制学基础。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: KRAS-mutant lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) shows limited benefit from immune checkpoint blockade (ICB), and the mechanisms by which oncogenic KRAS signaling promotes immune resistance remain poorly understood. Here, we sought to identify tumor-intrinsic mediators of KRAS-driven immune evasion and therapeutic resistance in LUAD. METHODS: Integrated analyses of human LUAD cohorts, genetically engineered mouse models, tumor cell models, and patient-derived organoids were performed to define the role of PRTN3 in immune regulation. PRTN3 regulation and function were investigated using transcriptional analyses, chromatin immunoprecipitation assays, biochemical cleavage assays, and immune cell co-culture systems. The therapeutic effect of PRTN3 inhibition was evaluated using flow cytometric immune profiling, functional immune assays, and syngeneic tumor models. RESULTS: We identified PRTN3 as a downstream effector of KRAS signaling that promotes immune evasion in LUAD. Mechanistically, KRAS signaling transcriptionally upregulated PRTN3 through c-Myc activation. Secreted PRTN3 directly cleaved and inactivated CXCL9 in the tumor microenvironment, disrupting CXCL9/CXCR3 signaling and impairing the recruitment and activation of cytotoxic CD8+ T cells and natural killer cells. In patients with LUAD, elevated PRTN3 expression was associated with reduced cytotoxic immune signatures and decreased CXCL9 activity. Genetic inhibition of PRTN3 enhanced antitumor immunity and improved responses to anti-programmed cell death protein 1 therapy in vivo. Furthermore, a hydrolysis-resistant CXCL9 variant restored cytotoxic lymphocyte activation and enhanced immune-mediated tumor cell killing in patient-derived organoids. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings reveal a KRAS/c-Myc/PRTN3 axis that promotes immune suppression through extracellular proteolytic inactivation of CXCL9. Targeting PRTN3-mediated immune evasion may represent a promising strategy to enhance ICB efficacy in KRAS-driven LUAD.

papers.title_zh: NLST低剂量胸部CT的核函数与视野标准化流程：改善定量肺气肿与体成分指标的一致性
papers.title_en: Harmonizing the National Lung Screening Trial: Kernel resolution and field of view compensation.
papers.authors: Krishnan AR, Kim ME, Gao C, Rudravaram G, Schwartz T, Hucke ATS, Remedios LW, Li TZ et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Vanderbilt University, Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America…
papers.results: 对23,669名参与者的105,191次扫描应用标准化流程；z轴空间分辨率重采样至1.0 mm；核函数映射至Siemens B30f（soft）和Siemens B50f（hard）；配对数据中标准化相对soft kernel参考改善定量指标一致性；跨截面分析显示核间变异降低，肺气肿百分比的效应量Cohen's d=0.2至0.5，视野扩展后与人体测量指标相关性改善；纵向线性混合效应模型显示核偏差降低、生物标志物纵向一致性改善（ICC升高）
papers.authors_conclusion: This work provides a harmonized NLST imaging resource that enables consistent and reliable quantitative biomarker estimation for lung cancer screening, with open source code released and the harmonized dataset to be made publicly available once data return to the NLST is completed.
papers.ai_note: 摘要未报告对肺癌筛查临床效能或下游诊断任务的外部验证；主要证据为定量指标一致性，“enables consistent and reliable quantitative biomarker estimation”存在外推；未见病灶保真度、放射科医生复核或独立外部测试集评估，相关信息不足。

pico.p: NLST参与者23,669例，共105,191次低剂量胸部CT扫描
pico.ic: 干预：z轴重采样至1.0 mm、基于解剖引导多路径cycleGAN的核函数统一（映射至Siemens B30f/B50f）、语义视野扩展；对照：标准化前异质性扫描及参考核函数

papers.reason: 为NLST这一肺癌筛查核心队列提供可复用的CT标准化资源，影响后续定量影像生物标志物研究的可重复性与跨中心比较基线。
papers.abstract_en: Low-dose chest computed tomography scans acquired in multi-centre studies exhibit heterogeneity in the form of varying spatial resolution, reconstruction kernel and semantic field-of-view that hinder the reproducibility of quantitative measures and generalizability of downstream analyses. The National Lung Screening Trial (NLST) provides a large, open collection of low-dose chest CT scans characterized by heterogeneous spatial resolution, reconstruction kernels and field-of-view configurations. This diversity presents an opportunity to standardize the data, enabling reproducible biomarker estimation and broader reuse of the NLST as a homogeneous quantitative imaging resource. In this work, we present a standardization pipeline that was applied to 105,191 scans from 23,669 participants in the NLST. The pipeline addresses the following elements: (1) Resampling through-axial-plane (z) spatial resolution to 1.0 mm (2) Harmonization of reconstruction kernels across intra-vendor (paired) and inter-vendor (unpaired) settings using an anatomy guided multipath cycleGAN where scans were mapped to a reference Siemens B30f (soft) and Siemens B50f (hard) kernel (3) Semantic field-of-view extension across all scans. Quantitative consistency across percent emphysema and body composition assessment (skeletal muscle and subcutaneous adipose tissue volumes) was evaluated in paired, cross-sectional and longitudinal settings. For paired data, harmonization improved agreement of quantitative measures relative to the soft kernel reference. Cross-sectional analyses demonstrated reduced inter-kernel variability, with small to medium effect sizes (Cohen's d = 0.2 to 0.5) for percent emphysema and improved correlations with anthropometric measures post field-of-view extension. Longitudinal analysis using linear mixed effect models, showed reduced kernel bias and improved longitudinal consistency of biomarkers reflected by the increase in intraclass correlation coefficients. This work provides a harmonized NLST imaging resource that enables consistent and reliable quantitative biomarker estimation for lung cancer screening, with open source code released at https://github.com/MASILab/Harmonized_NLST_dataset and the harmonized dataset to be made publicly available once data return to the NLST is completed.

papers.title_zh: 在KRAS G12C突变NSCLC临床前模型中，FAK抑制剂联合RAF/MEK钳制剂avutometinib增强KRAS G12C抑制剂疗效并恢复sotorasib耐药模型敏感性
papers.title_en: FAK inhibitor and RAF/MEK clamp avutometinib enhance KRAS G12C inhibitor efficacy in preclinical models of non-small cell lung cancer.
papers.authors: Coma S, Musteanu M, Malvezzi CC, Jamieson RR, Patrucco E, Mira A, Dilly J, Li Z et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Verastem Oncology, Needham, MA 02494, USA.
papers.authors_conclusion: 同时靶向KRAS G12C、RAF/MEK和FAK信号可克服多种耐药机制，并为在KRAS G12C突变NSCLC患者中临床评估sotorasib、avutometinib和defactinib提供有力依据（RAMP 203；NCT05074810）。
papers.ai_note: 证据仅来自临床前小鼠模型，尚无患者疗效或安全性数据；摘要未给出样本量、效应量、置信区间或P值，“增强抗肿瘤活性”“恢复敏感性”均为定性描述；作者据此提出开展临床试验的“strong rationale”属于外推性判断，需人体试验验证。

pico.p: KRAS G12C突变NSCLC小鼠模型，包括对sotorasib耐药的小鼠模型；样本量摘要未提及
pico.ic: sotorasib+avutometinib+defactinib三药联合，对照为sotorasib单药或sotorasib+avutometinib双药；并评估FAK/PI3K等适应性耐药通路

papers.reason: 为KRAS G12C突变NSCLC靶向治疗耐药后的联合策略提供临床前机制依据，并直接支撑RAMP 203三药联合试验设计；对理解RAF/MEK与FAK抑制联用的耐药克服逻辑有参考价值。
papers.abstract_en: KRAS G12C (Gly12→Cys) inhibitors (G12Cis) have improved outcomes for patients with KRAS G12C-mutated non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but their clinical benefit is limited by the emergence of resistance mechanisms. Here, we demonstrate that combining the RAF/MEK clamp avutometinib and the focal adhesion kinase (FAK) inhibitor defactinib with a G12Ci enhanced antitumor activity by deepening mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK) pathway suppression and simultaneously inhibiting adaptive resistance pathways induced by G12Ci and avutometinib treatment, including FAK and PI3K signaling. In KRAS G12C NSCLC mouse models, the triplet combination produced greater tumor growth inhibition than either sotorasib alone or the sotorasib plus avutometinib doublet. Moreover, in KRAS G12C NSCLC mouse models resistant to sotorasib, the addition of avutometinib and FAK inhibition restored sensitivity to sotorasib and increased both the depth and durability of antitumor responses. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that concurrent targeting of KRAS G12C, RAF/MEK, and FAK signaling can overcome multiple resistance mechanisms and provide a strong rationale for the clinical evaluation of sotorasib, avutometinib, and defactinib in patients with KRAS G12C-mutated NSCLC (RAMP 203; NCT05074810).

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: With the increasing detection of synchronous bilateral pulmonary nodules in clinical practice, both one-stage and two-stage video-assisted thoracic surgery (VATS) have been widely applied. This study protocol describes the OTVATS-2 trial, which aims to compare perioperative complications and long-term outcomes between these two surgical strategies. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: A prospective, multicentre, randomised controlled clinical trial will be conducted to compare the surgical outcomes of one-stage versus two-stage VATS in patients with synchronous bilateral pulmonary nodules. A total of 256 patients will be enrolled from three academic institutions in China. This trial is expected to last for 2 years, with patient recruitment starting in July 2025. The primary outcome is perioperative complication rate within 30 days. Secondary outcomes including 5-year overall survival, 5-year disease-free survival, surgical time, blood loss, duration of chest tube, length of stay, postoperative pain scores, quality of life scores as well as anxiety and depression scores. ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: This study has been approved by the Ethics Committee of China-Japan Friendship Hospital (No. 2025-KY-150) and the institutional review boards of all participating centres, including the Ethics Committees of Peking University Third Hospital and Beijing Hospital. Written informed consent will be obtained from all enrolled participants. Results of the research will be published in a peer-reviewed journal. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: ChiCTR 2500106215.

papers.abstract_en: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have changed the treatment landscape of pleural mesothelioma (PM) over the past decade. This review summarizes the history of immunotherapy in PM, covering studies of single-agent immunotherapy, combination checkpoint blockade, the integration of ICIs into frontline therapeutic strategies, and ICI-VEGF combinations. Also discussed are the emerging role of biomarkers in guiding first-line therapy selection for patients with PM and novel therapeutic approaches. Dual checkpoint blockade targeting PD-1 and CTLA-4 demonstrated clinical efficacy in early-phase studies and led to the pivotal phase III CheckMate 743 trial, which established nivolumab and ipilimumab as a standard first-line systemic therapy for PM, particularly in patients with nonepithelioid histology. Since that time, other combination therapy approaches have been explored. For example, chemoimmunotherapy studies have evaluated ICIs, including pembrolizumab and durvalumab, in combination with platinum chemotherapy, with pembrolizumab plus platinum-doublet chemotherapy expanding the approved frontline treatment options for PM. VEGF inhibition, validated in the phase III MAPS study, provided a biologic rationale for combining antiangiogenic agents with ICIs. This prompted investigation of bevacizumab in combination with atezolizumab and chemotherapy in the BEAT-meso study. Unfortunately, this combination did not provide meaningful benefit in this setting. Optimal patient selection and treatment sequencing remain undefined. Although robust data support the use of second-line immunotherapy after first-line chemotherapy, there is a paucity of evidence regarding the efficacy of chemotherapy following frontline ICI. Despite advancements in therapeutic options in PM, biomarker-driven treatment selection remains limited at this time. Future large clinical studies must incorporate validated and standardized biomarker subanalyses, including approaches such as circulating tumor DNA and multiomics, for biomarkers to become clinically relevant in this heterogeneous malignancy. Finally, novel therapeutic strategies, including bispecific antibodies, targeted therapies, perioperative immunotherapy, vaccines, and cellular therapies, are under active investigation and may further expand treatment options for patients with PM.

papers.title_zh: 深度学习CBCT肺肿瘤与食管自动分割模型的外部验证：跨机构域偏移下分割精度下降且GTV剂量学存在偏差
papers.title_en: External evaluation of a deep learning-based algorithm for automated lung tumor and esophagus segmentation on CBCT.
papers.authors: Zhang Z, Hobbis D, Jiang J, Rangnekar A, Choi C, Waters M, Veeraraghavan H, Hugo G et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Radiation Oncology, WashU Medicine, St.
papers.results: GTV：模型平均DSC由刚性传播的0.66提高至0.76；模型轮廓与参考轮廓GTV D98%差异有统计学意义（50.69 vs 53.58 Gy）。与模型原测试集（与训练集同分布，平均DSC=0.84）相比，性能下降无统计学意义。食管：6例26次扫描，靶周轮廓环内几何精度与刚性传播相当，平均DSC分别为0.72与0.70；模型与参考轮廓的食管V32Gy相似（0.06 vs 0.06 cc）；与此前报道结果相比精度显著下降，平均DSC由0.79降至0.72。
papers.authors_conclusion: DL-based CBCT auto-segmentation may suffer performance degradation under domain shifts across patient populations, clinical workflows, and imaging systems, emphasizing the necessity of external evaluation beyond the original development environment.
papers.ai_note: 摘要未给出任何P值或95%CI，却对GTV（0.84→0.76）下“下降无统计学意义”的判断，样本量小（12例）使该阴性判断功效不足；GTV D98%出现约2.9 Gy的显著剂量学偏差，提示DSC提升不等于靶区覆盖可靠，摘要未进一步展开其临床含义；食管“精度相当”限定于靶周轮廓环内评估，且以刚性传播这一弱基线为参照；主要终点与次要终点未明确分层，缺少参考轮廓生成方式（人工/多观察者）与失败病例描述。

pico.p: 外部独立队列12例肺癌患者，每人5幅CBCT（共60幅，O-ring加速器、另一机构采集）；食管分割子分析纳入6例患者共26次扫描
pico.ic: 基于C-arm直线加速器CBCT预训练的DL模型直接应用于O-ring加速器CBCT；对照为计划CT轮廓的刚性传播（rigid propagation），以几何（DSC）与剂量学指标评估GTV与食管分割

papers.reason: 为在线自适应放疗中CBCT自动分割的跨机构可迁移性提供直接证据：提示外部部署时GTV分割精度虽优于刚性传播但仍存在剂量学偏差、食管精度显著下降，可影响自适应放疗中自动分割是否可免于人工修订的流程决策，并为分割模型外部验证研究提供对照基线设计参考。
papers.abstract_en: Online adaptive radiotherapy requires fast and accurate delineation of targets and organs at risk on cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT). Although deep learning (DL)-based CBCT auto-segmentation methods have been proposed, their clinical generalizability remains insufficiently validated. This study aimed to externally evaluate a pretrained DL model for lung tumor and esophagus segmentation on CBCT. Originally trained using C-arm linac CBCT images, the model was directly applied to an independent cohort of 12 lung cancer patients, each with 5 CBCT images acquired at a separate institution on an O-ring linac. Rigid propagation of planning CT contours served as a minimal baseline to determine whether the model matched or outperformed conventional rigid registration for gross tumor volume (GTV) and esophagus segmentation using geometric and dosimetric measures. Compared with rigid contour propagation, the model significantly improved GTV segmentation accuracy, with mean Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) increasing from 0.66 to 0.76. Significant differences in GTV D98% were observed between the model-generated contours and the reference contours (50.69 vs 53.58 Gy). The model showed a statistically non-significant decrease in performance compared with previously reported results on its original testing dataset (mean DSC = 0.84), which shared the same distribution as the training dataset. For esophagus segmentation, evaluation of 26 scans from 6 patients showed that the model achieved geometric accuracy within peri-target contour rings comparable to rigid propagation, with mean DSC of 0.72 and 0.70, respectively. Similar esophagus V32Gy values were observed between the model-generated and reference contours (0.06 vs 0.06 cc). Significantly reduced accuracy was observed compared with previously reported results, with mean DSC decreasing from 0.79 to 0.72. These findings highlight that DL-based CBCT auto-segmentation may suffer performance degradation under domain shifts across patient populations, clinical workflows, and imaging systems, emphasizing the necessity of external evaluation beyond the original development environment.

papers.results: 模拟产生与临床数据一致的PK、ORR、DCR及探索性OS趋势；无需拟合个体轨迹、不增设应答隔室、不为复现ORR/DCR而重新调参即出现异质性肿瘤轨迹；肿瘤生长动力学与靶点表达特征（组织学评分、抗原阳性细胞比例）与应答相关，但应答者/非应答者分布重叠；TS-OS子模型复现中位OS与生存趋势；肿瘤生长速率为与生存关联最强的输入；跨剂量比较中5.4 mg/kg Q3W T-DXd与6 mg/kg Q3W Dato-DXd在预测疗效与瘤外组织载荷暴露方面最优，与获批剂量一致

papers.ai_note: 无个体水平肿瘤大小与生存数据，TS-OS关系建模时未纳入ADC治疗人群，其“可迁移性”仅为模拟复现中位OS与趋势，属事后一致性检验而非前瞻验证；“与临床数据一致”未给出任何定量一致性指标（偏差%、区间覆盖率等），无法判断拟合优度；仅2个参数由群体PK估计，其余全部取自文献/独立实验，参数不确定性与敏感性分析未在摘要呈现；以“优选剂量与获批剂量相符”作为支持性证据存在一定循环论证色彩；作者自述应答者/非应答者分布重叠、判别力有限，提示该框架尚不能替代预测性生物标志物；摘要未报告样本量、剂量组数及任何P/CI值，信息不足以评估统计稳健性

papers.abstract_en: Antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) development in solid tumors faces efficacy and safety challenges from heterogeneous target expression, limited tumor penetration, and off-target payload exposure. We developed a spatial quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) framework integrating ADC-analyte physiologically based pharmacokinetics (PBPK), a Krogh-cylinder tumor model, and a non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) tumor size-overall survival (TS-OS) relationship developed without ADC-treated populations. Applied to trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in HER2-mutant NSCLC and datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd), a TROP2-directed ADC, in EGFR-mutated NSCLC, all parameters came from literature or independent assays; only nonspecific antibody uptake and unconjugated-payload hepatic clearances were estimated from population-level T-DXd serum PK. Using a common structure and virtual-patient framework with independently informed ADC-specific inputs, simulations generated PK, objective response rate (ORR), disease control rate (DCR), and exploratory OS trends consistent with clinical data. Heterogeneous tumor trajectories emerged without fitting individual trajectories, adding ad hoc response compartments, or retuning tumor growth solely to reproduce ORR/DCR. Tumor growth kinetics and target-expression characteristics, represented by histological score and antigen-positive cell fraction, were associated with response, but responder/non-responder distributions overlapped, indicating limited discrimination and need for predictive biomarkers. The TS-OS sub-model reproduced median OS and survival trends, supporting transportability despite absent individual-level tumor and survival data. Tumor growth rate was the strongest survival-associated input, consistent with TS-OS covariate structure. Across doses, 5.4 mg/kg Q3W T-DXd and 6 mg/kg Q3W Dato-DXd were preferred based on predicted efficacy and off-tumor tissue payload exposure, consistent with approved doses. The framework supports ADC design and dose evaluation despite limited individual-level data.

papers.abstract_en: Discoidin domain receptor 1 (DDR1), a collagen-activated receptor tyrosine kinase, is essential for tumor cell proliferation, invasion and drug resistance. Our study demonstrated that the expression and phosphorylation of DDR1 were associated not only with the poor outcome of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but also with low sensitivity to docetaxel. Moreover, our kinase profiling identified that anlotinib, an oral small-molecule tyrosine kinase inhibitor, could significantly inhibit DDR1 phosphorylation. Further data revealed that anlotinib could increase the sensitivity to docetaxel in cell lines, cell-derived and patient-derived tumor xenografts through down-regulating DDR1 phosphorylation, which no longer existed in DDR1-KO A549 cells. Mechanistically, anlotinib could enhance the sensitivity to docetaxel through inhibiting DDR1-mediated glycolysis. Additionally, the clinical trial demonstrated that anlotinib could increase the efficacy of docetaxel, with an improved overall response rate of 35.6%, a prolonged median progression-free survival by 5.3 months and a median overall survival by 14.0 months compared with historical data. In summary, our study not only highlights the new function of DDR1 in energy metabolism but also provides further evidence for the combination of anlotinib and docetaxel as a preferable strategy in clinical practice.

papers.abstract_en: CHORUS (NCT04905316) was an open-label, non-randomized, single-arm phase I/II trial of the anti-IL-1beta monoclonal antibody canakinumab given with concurrent chemoradiotherapy and continued with anti-PD-L1 durvalumab consolidation in unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer. The primary endpoint was 24-month progression-free survival (PFS) from radiotherapy initiation; secondary endpoints included overall survival, objective response rate, and safety. Forty-one patients were enrolled, 37 received canakinumab, and 32 comprised the prespecified efficacy population. At a median follow-up of 25 months, 24-month PFS was 67% (95% confidence interval, 52-88); the lower bound of the prespecified one-sided 90% confidence interval was 56.5%, exceeding the 46% historical benchmark, and the primary endpoint was met. Twelve- and 24-month overall survival were 93% and 73%, respectively, and the confirmed objective response rate was 81%. Canakinumab-related grade 3-4 events included neutropenia (n = 5), febrile neutropenia (n = 1), lymphopenia (n = 1), lung infection (n = 1), fatigue (n = 1), and hypertension (n = 1); no canakinumab-related deaths occurred. Pneumonitis of any attribution occurred in 9 of 37 patients (24%; grade 2, n = 7; grade 3, n = 2). Peripheral immune cell profiling showed attenuated expansion of myeloid-derived suppressor cells and CTLA-4-expressing CD8 + T-cell subsets among responders. Circulating tumor DNA cleared by week 6 in 20 of 30 evaluable patients (66%). These findings support randomized evaluation of interleukin-1β blockade in this setting.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: The increasing adoption of targeted therapies over chemotherapy has made randomized controlled trials (RCT) with chemotherapy increasingly challenging in advanced NSCLC with actionable genomic alterations (AGA), particularly for rare subgroups. Contemporary chemotherapy outcomes specific to AGAs are lacking despite growing reliance on single-arm studies and external-control analyses. We sought to establish first-line platinum-doublet chemotherapy outcomes in advanced NSCLC with AGAs using data from RCTs. METHODS: We extracted objective response rate (ORR), progression-free survival (PFS), and overall survival (OS) data from Phase 2/3 RCTs. Individual patient-level data were reconstructed from Kaplan-Meier curves to pool and compare PFS and OS across AGAs. RESULTS: Twenty-two RCTs (n = 2132) were included. Across most AGAs, platinum-doublet chemotherapy produced similar outcomes-pooled ORRs ranging from 28.7 to 39.0% and median PFS from 6.0 to 7.3 months. Pairwise comparisons showed better ORR/PFS for RET fusion (one trial with control arm-chemotherapy/pembrolizumab) and shorter OS for KRAS mutation versus other AGAs (logrank P<.001). Detailed pooled ORR and median PFS and OS were: ALK rearrangement (n = 461)-ORR 39.0% (95% CI 25.8-52.2), PFS 7.0 months (6.8-7.2), OS 43.0 months (32.2-inestimable); common EGFR mutation (n = 1038)-ORR 28.7% (22.3-35.1), PFS 6.0 months (5.7-6.3), OS 27.4 months (26.1-29.3); uncommon EGFR mutation (n = 61)-ORR 35.1% (12.6-57.7), PFS 6.7 months (5.2-8.4), OS 29.5 months (13.3-inestimable); EGFR exon 20 insertion (n = 330)-ORR 38.3% (21.7-55.0), PFS 7.3 months (6.9-8.6), OS 30.1 months (29.1-inestimable); KRAS mutation (n = 140)-ORR 21.7% (12.4-30.9), PFS 6.2 months (4.7-6.9), OS 10.8 months (8.8-12.7); RET fusion (n = 102)-ORR 65.0% (54.5-75.5), PFS 11.4 months (8.9-16.9), OS not available. CONCLUSION: Platinum-doublet chemotherapy yields remarkably consistent ORR and PFS across most advanced NSCLC with AGAs. These data provide contemporary molecularly defined benchmarks that may support interpretation of single-arm studies, development of external-control analyses, and future trial design in this rare population.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Evidence for adding dexketoprofen trometamol to sufentanil-based patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA) after thoracoscopic radical resection of lung cancer remains limited. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate 48-hour opioid consumption, pain outcomes, and short-term adverse events with dexketoprofen trometamol plus sufentanil versus sufentanil-based PCIA alone. METHODS: In this randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 108 patients scheduled for thoracoscopic radical resection of lung cancer were randomized preoperatively (54 per group). After 18 post-randomization exclusions before PCIA initiation, 45 patients per group received the allocated intervention and were analyzed. All underwent unilateral uniportal anatomical segmentectomy with mediastinal lymph node dissection or sampling and received a standardized intercostal nerve block. Group S received sufentanil-based PCIA, and Group R additionally received dexketoprofen trometamol. The primary outcome was total 48-hour postoperative sufentanil consumption, including rescue doses. RESULTS: Sufentanil consumption was lower in Group R than in Group S (78.03 ± 10.66 vs 96.78 ± 13.69 μg; reduction 18.75 μg, 95% CI 13.61 to 23.89; P<0.001), representing an approximately 19% reduction. Resting pain scores were lower at 12 and 24 hours (both P=0.004), meeting the revised Bonferroni threshold of P<0.005 for 10 time-point comparisons; the coughing-pain difference at 12 hours (P=0.006) did not meet this threshold. Resting-pain area under the curve was lower (P=0.009), but generalized estimating equations showed no significant overall group effect or group-by-time interaction for resting or coughing pain. Nausea occurred in 11.1% versus 28.9% (Pearson χ2 P=0.035). CONCLUSION: Adding dexketoprofen trometamol reduced 48-hour sufentanil consumption in the analyzed population. Pain differences were time-specific secondary findings and did not establish sustained analgesic superiority. The nausea finding requires confirmation, and the trial was insufficient to establish safety for uncommon adverse events.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: To systematically compare the effects of Baduanjin exercise, bedside cycle ergometer training, and balloon-blowing training on pulmonary function recovery in patients undergoing thoracoscopic radical resection for lung cancer. METHODS: This study is a prospective randomized controlled trial. From January, 2021 to June, 2022, 334 patients undergoing thoracoscopic radical resection for lung cancer were enrolled and randomly assigned to Baduanjin group (108 cases), bedside cycle ergometer training group (109 cases), and balloon-blowing training group (117 cases). All the patients received 12 weeks of assigned intervention. Systematic assessments of lung function, exercise tolerance, dyspnea level, pain intensity, immune function, aerobic capacity, quality of life, and patient engagement were conducted at postoperative day 1 (baseline), 4 weeks, 12 weeks, 6 months, and 1 year postoperatively. RESULTS: At 12 weeks postoperatively, all observed indicators in the 3 groups showed significant improvement compared to the baseline levels (P<0.05). Baduanjin exercise resulted in the most pronounced improvements in immune function indicators (CD4+/CD8+ ratio, IgA, and IgG levels), pain intensity, dyspnea score, quality of life score, and treatment engagement, outperforming the other two trainings (P<0.05). The patients in bedside cycle ergometer group showed significantly more obvious improvements in forced expiratory volume in one second (FEV1), 6-min walking distance, and peak oxygen uptake (VO₂peak) than those in balloon-blowing training group (P<0.05), but these improvements did not differ significantly from those observed in Baduanjin group (P>0.05). Balloon-blowing training resulted in only limited overall improvements of the measured indicators. CONCLUSIONS: Baduanjin, bedside cycle ergometer training and balloon-blowing training are all effective rehabilitation methods after video-assisted thoracoscopic radical resection for lung cancer. Personalized rehabilitation choices can be provided for patients based on their rehabilitation needs.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3) regulates the inflammatory response. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between perioperative serum NLRP3 levels and postoperative delirium (POD) in elderly patients with lung cancer. METHODS: In this observational analytical study, serum NLRP3 levels were measured preoperatively and postoperatively in 266 elderly patients with lung cancer and at study entry in 100 controls. We used the American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) Scale, Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI), and Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Scaleto classify patients' preoperative physical fitness. Patients were assessed for POD from the first to the third postoperative day using the Chinese Confusion Assessment Method. Predictors of POD were determined using multivariate analysis. RESULTS: Preoperative and postoperative serum NLRP3 levels in patients were significantly higher than those in controls, with the highest levels observed postoperatively. Postoperative blood C-reactive protein levels and ECOG scores were independently correlated with postoperative serum NLRP3 levels. Postoperative serum NLRP3 levels, ASA classifications, and CCI were independently associated with POD. The nomogram model incorporating the three independent predictors of POD was confirmed to have good discrimination, calibration, and clinical utility based on the receiver operating characteristic curve, calibration curve, and decision curve. Compared with the clinical model (CCI + ASA), the nomogram model demonstrated significant improvement in risk reclassification, with a continuous NRI of 0.7198 (95% CI, 0.4366-1.003) and an IDI of 0.0867 (95% CI, 0.041-0.1323); however, the improvement in AUC did not reach statistical significance. Internal validation through 10-fold cross-validation demonstrated that the nomogram model had good predictive accuracy based on the optimism-corrected area under the curve. CONCLUSION: Significantly increased postoperative serum NLRP3 levels are independently associated with POD in elderly patients with lung cancer, and the model integrating serum NLRP3 levels shows favorable predictive performance for POD.

papers.results: Harrell C-index：训练 0.785（95%CI 0.767-0.793）、内部验证 0.819（95%CI 0.788-0.833）、外部验证 0.785（95%CI 0.752-0.802）。高危表型富集 HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS（NES=1.696, FDR=0.045），另有 MYC targets 与 inflammatory response 富集；HALLMARK_HYPOXIA 仅呈正向趋势，未达预设探索性阈值。13 个受评 TF 中 11 个达到预设 FDR 阈值（含 YAP1、MYC、HIF1A、E2F3、STAT3、KLF4、E2F1、TP53），整合分析优先排序 HIF1A、STAT3、TP53、YAP1、E2F1/E2F3。110 例无监督聚类（独立于 RadScore 标签）得三种 TF 状态：Hypoxia_Metabolic n=69、Cell_Cycle_E2F n=31、Hippo_Mechanosensing n=10。
papers.authors_conclusion: CT 影像组学定义的不良预后表型与一致的转录组程序及可解释的 TF 调控架构相关；该框架将常规影像表型与潜在肿瘤调控程序联系起来，并支持基于调控状态的治疗假设生成。
papers.ai_note: 全文未报告任何生存终点（OS/DFS）的风险分层数值或 HR，结论主要建立在替代性分子富集证据上；GSEA 仅 E2F_TARGETS 一项达 FDR 阈值，缺氧等预设方向性结果未达阈值，属探索性发现，易被读作机制确证。所谓“internal validation”与 402 例训练队列的关系未说明拆分方式，存在数据泄漏疑虑。Hippo_Mechanosensing 簇仅 10 例，聚类稳定性与可重复性信息不足。TF 活性由靶基因推断而非直接测量，LINCS 药物假设无任何实验或临床验证。

pico.p: 训练队列 402 例（NSCLC-Radiomics, TCIA）；外部验证 110 例（NSCLC Radiogenomics）；均为治疗前 CT 且配转录组数据

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: To determine whether a CT radiomics-defined poor-prognosis phenotype in NSCLC is associated with reproducible transcriptomic programs and distinct transcription factor (TF) activity patterns. METHODS: This retrospective radiogenomic study used public datasets from The Cancer Imaging Archive. A prognostic radiomics model was developed from pretreatment CT in 402 patients from the NSCLC-Radiomics collection and evaluated in an independent cohort of 110 patients from the NSCLC Radiogenomics collection. Seven tumor-centered intra- and peritumoral regions were analyzed. Features were extracted from original, wavelet-, and Laplacian-of-Gaussian-filtered CT images. After preprocessing and training-cohort standardization, a LASSO-penalized Cox model was developed. The locked model retained eight features, all from the GTV+10-mm region, and was applied to the internal and external validation cohorts without refitting. The training-cohort median RadScore was used unchanged for Kaplan-Meier visualization. Matched transcriptomic data were analyzed using preranked gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), gene set variation analysis (GSVA), target-gene-based TF activity inference, TF co-activity networks, exploratory regulator prioritization, unsupervised TF-state clustering, and LINCS-based perturbational analysis. RESULTS: The radiomics model achieved Harrell concordance indices of 0.785 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.767-0.793), 0.819 (95% CI, 0.788-0.833), and 0.785 (95% CI, 0.752-0.802) in the training, internal validation, and external validation cohorts, respectively. The high-risk phenotype showed exploratory enrichment of proliferative and stress-adaptive programs, led by HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS (normalized enrichment score [NES] = 1.696, false discovery rate [FDR] = 0.045), with additional enrichment of MYC targets and inflammatory response. HALLMARK_HYPOXIA showed a positive directional trend but did not meet the prespecified exploratory threshold. GSVA provided complementary sample-level evidence for MYC targets, hypoxia, E2F targets, DNA repair, and cell-cycle activity. Eleven of 13 evaluated TFs met the prespecified FDR threshold, including YAP1, MYC, HIF1A, E2F3, STAT3, KLF4, E2F1, and TP53. Integrated analysis prioritized HIF1A, STAT3, TP53, YAP1, and E2F1/E2F3 as candidate regulatory nodes. Unsupervised clustering of all 110 radiogenomic patients, performed independently of radiomics risk labels, identified three exploratory TF-defined states: Hypoxia_Metabolic (n = 69), Cell_Cycle_E2F (n = 31), and Hippo_Mechanosensing (n = 10). LINCS-based analysis generated regulatory-state-associated compound hypotheses. CONCLUSIONS: A CT radiomics-defined poor-prognosis phenotype in NSCLC is associated with coherent transcriptomic programs and an interpretable TF regulatory architecture. This framework links routine imaging phenotypes to latent tumor-control programs and supports regulatory-state-informed therapeutic hypothesis generation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND/AIM: Immune-nutritional status and gut microbiota composition have been proposed as biomarkers of response to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). However, their interrelationship and longitudinal dynamics during immunotherapy remain unclear. PATIENTS AND METHODS: In this multicenter prospective study, patients with advanced or recurrent NSCLC treated with atezolizumab-based immunotherapy were enrolled. Serial fecal samples were analyzed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Immune-nutritional status was evaluated using the prognostic nutritional index (PNI). Associations between baseline PNI, gut microbiota composition, treatment response, immune-related adverse events (irAEs), and longitudinal microbiota changes were assessed. RESULTS: Sixty-five patients were included (27 responders and 38 non-responders). Pretreatment PNI was significantly associated with treatment response (p=0.0048) and improved progression-free and overall survival. During follow-up, 12 patients (18.5%) developed irAEs. Lachnospiraceae UCG-008 was enriched in patients with high PNI and in those without irAEs. Longitudinal analysis showed stable abundance of this taxon during treatment with no significant temporal changes. CONCLUSION: Pretreatment gut microbiota composition was associated with immune-nutritional status and clinical outcomes in patients with NSCLC receiving atezolizumab-based immunotherapy. Lachnospiraceae UCG-008 was linked to favorable host status and lower irAE risk, remaining stable during treatment. These findings suggest that baseline gut microbiota may serve as a clinically relevant biomarker for both the efficacy and safety of immunotherapy.

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Hypoxia-pyroptosis-associated long noncoding RNAs (HP-lncRNAs) may contribute to cancer progression and treatment resistance, but their prognostic and mechanistic roles in lung cancer remain unclear. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate their prognostic value and regulatory networks in lung cancer. METHODS: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines, we systematically searched five scientific databases up to November 20, 2025, for studies evaluating HP-lncRNA expression and survival outcomes. Hazard ratios (HRs) were pooled by using random-effects models, with heterogeneity being assessed by I2. Subgroup analyses examined histology, tumor stage, and study design. Mechanistic evidence and protein-interaction networks were also synthesized. RESULTS: A total of 27 studies were included, with 14 providing quantitative data for meta-analysis. High expression of HP-lncRNA signatures was significantly associated with poorer overall survival (pooled adjusted HR = 1.50; 95% CI, 1.23-1.84), with a pronounced effect in lung adenocarcinoma (adjusted HR = 1.64; 95% CI, 1.34-1.99). Subgroup analyses supported a consistent adverse association across cohort designs and showed that the association remained evident in the advanced-stage subgroup (adjusted HR = 1.60; 95% CI, 1.44-1.77), although clear stage-specific effect modification was not demonstrated. Mechanistic evidence linked some lncRNAs to hypoxia-related regulation and others to pyroptosis-related signaling. Although direct evidence of a single lncRNA connecting both pathways is limited, findings support possible hypoxia-pyroptosis crosstalk. HIF-1a and caspase-1 emerged as central hub genes. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings suggest that HP-lncRNA signatures may have prognostic relevance and therapeutic potential in lung cancer; however, the marked between-study heterogeneity indicates that further standardization and external validation are required before clinical application.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: To validate the accuracy and reliability of the microwave ablation (MWA) planning system in predicting the postablation target zone (PTZ) in lung tumors after computed tomography (CT)-guided MWA and analyze its potential influencing factors. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective analysis of 118 patients with 134 lung tumors, who underwent CT-guided MWA from May 2020 to September 2021, was conducted. CT images were collected at 24 hours and 1 month after MWA to evaluate the local effect and complications. The differences between the size and shape of the actual PTZ and predicted ones were compared, and the factors affecting PTZ were also analyzed. RESULTS: The predicted long diameters, short diameters, and spherical index (SI) of PTZ detected at 24 hours after MWA were basically consistent with the actual ones, but significantly larger than those detected at 1 month after MWA, and the difference was more pronounced in the short diameter than in the long diameter. The lesion diameter and ablation power had an independent effect on the ablation index (AI) at 24 hours after MWA ( P < 0.05), and there was a significant difference in AI between invasive adenocarcinoma and atypical adenomatoid hyperplasia at 24 hours after MWA ( P < 0.05). CONCLUSION: The size and shape of the PTZ predicted by MWA planning system were basically consistent with the actual ones detected at 24 hours after MWA. However, by 1 month, the predicted values of the long diameter, short diameter, and SIs were all significantly higher than the actual ones. PTZ is positively correlated with lesion size and ablation power, and different pathological types can also affect the ablation zone.

papers.abstract_en: Pulmonary nodules are highly prevalent in adult human populations, with a substantial proportion representing dormant cancerous lesions. We hypothesized that these pulmonary dormant cancers debilitate in growth owing to the lack of an angiogenic switch in tumors. In this study, we comprehensively investigated the hypothesis that specific pathological triggers can activate this angiogenic switch utilizing severe acute respiratory coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection-induced hypoxia as a primary physiological stimulus. Our findings provide compelling experimental evidence demonstrating that SARS-CoV-2 infection induces profound pulmonary hypoxia and severe tissue inflammation in animal models. This microenvironmental disruption markedly upregulates the expression of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2 (VEGFR2) within lung tissues. The resulting hyperactivation of the downstream VEGF-VEGFR2 signaling pathway effectively drives robust pulmonary neovascularization, a phenomenon frequently documented in clinical observations of COVID-19 patients. Furthermore, employing an established experimental tumor model, we demonstrated that SARS-CoV-2 infection directly accelerates tumor outgrowth via this specific VEGF angiogenesis-dependent cascade. Crucially, the targeted administration of a neutralizing antibody to block VEGF significantly suppressed tumor progression and outgrowth in SARS-CoV-2-infected, tumor-bearing animals. Our data show that the COVID-19-induced hypoxia-VEGF-angiogenesis axis serves as one of the mechanisms for initiating tumor outgrowth in pulmonary tissues.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Major pathological response (MPR) is a widely used efficacy endpoint for neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy (NCIT) in resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). However, whether MPR without pathological complete response (pCR) represents a prognostically homogeneous population remains unclear, and optimal postoperative management strategies require further exploration. This study evaluated the prognostic heterogeneity, risk stratification, and recurrence patterns of patients achieving MPR. METHODS: This dual-center, retrospective cohort study included 588 patients with resectable NSCLC who received NCIT followed by radical surgery. The primary endpoint was recurrence-free survival (RFS). Patients were categorized into mutually exclusive pCR (n=200), non-pCR MPR (≤10% residual viable tumor without pCR; n = 111), and Non-MPR (n=277) groups. Kaplan-Meier curves and multivariable Cox proportional hazards regression were used to evaluate prognostic factors and develop a risk-stratification system within the MPR subgroup. Additionally, the effect of postoperative adjuvant therapy was evaluated via exploratory subgroup analyses, and anatomical recurrence patterns were systematically compared across response groups. RESULTS: Recurrence-free survival (RFS) differed among the three groups, with MPR representing an intermediate-risk state. Within the MPR subgroup, baseline cT3-4 stage, postoperative ypN positivity, and lower harvested lymph node count were independently associated with RFS. A simplified system effectively divided MPR patients into low-risk (RFS comparable to pCR) and high-risk groups (RFS approaching Non-MPR). Adjuvant therapy showed no statistically significant RFS benefit in pathological response subgroups. Furthermore, recurrence patterns did not significantly differ among response groups, with brain and bone remaining the predominant distant metastatic sites. CONCLUSIONS: Non-pCR MPR after NCIT is a prognostically heterogeneous state in NSCLC. Stratifying these patients using baseline cT stage, ypN status, and lymph node count refines postoperative risk assessment, highlighting the continued necessity of thorough lymph node dissection. Although adjuvant therapy did not show a definitive RFS benefit in our cohort, its potential value, especially in high-risk MPR patients, warrants prospective validation and should not be interpreted as evidence of lack of benefit. Furthermore, the observed recurrence patterns across response groups, with brain and bone being frequently observed metastatic sites, provide preliminary insights into metastatic distribution after NCIT and may serve as a reference for future surveillance studies.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Previous evidence demonstrated that neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy provides significant prognostic benefits for non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). While the efficacy of serplulimab, an anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody, has been well established in advanced driver gene-negative NSCLC in the ASTRUM-004 trial, its efficacy in the neoadjuvant setting remains unclear. This real-world study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of neoadjuvant serplulimab plus chemotherapy in patients with locally advanced squamous NSCLC, with a particular focus on pathological response outcomes. METHODS: This was a multicenter, retrospective-prospective, real-world observational study. Electronic medical records were retrospectively reviewed to identify eligible patients with locally advanced squamous NSCLC who received at least 1 cycle of neoadjuvant serplulimab (300 mg, Q3W) combined with platinum-taxane chemotherapy. Prospective follow-up was conducted to complete courses and outcomes. The primary endpoint was major pathologic response (MPR), and the secondary endpoints included pathological complete response (pCR), objective response rate (ORR), event-free survival (EFS), overall survival (OS), and safety. RESULTS: Thirty patients were included (median age 64 years; 96.7% male; 86.7% stage III). Most patients received two cycles of neoadjuvant therapy (46.67%), and 80% achieved a radiologic ORR (95% CI, 61.4-92.3%). Surgery was performed on 28 patients (93.33%), with MPR and pCR achieved in 57.1% (95% CI, 39.1-73.5%) and 28.6% (95% CI, 15.3-47.1%), respectively, and an R0 resection rate of 92.9%. Compared with the historical chemotherapy group, the observed MPR was significantly higher (57.1% vs 8.9% and 11.0%; P < 0.001). The median EFS reached 29.97 months, and the 12-month EFS rate was 91.8% (95% CI, 81.4-100%). The OS data were immature. Grade 3 adverse events occurred in 6.7% of patients, and no grade 4-5 events or perioperative immune-related complications were reported. Exploratory analyses revealed that a lower post-treatment neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR< 3) was positively correlated with MPR, whereas advanced T stage (T3-T4) was negatively associated. CONCLUSION: Neoadjuvant serplulimab-chemotherapy demonstrated promising efficacy and manageable toxicity in real-world locally advanced NSCLC. Survival outcomes require longer follow-up to assess clinical benefit.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pathological complete response (pCR) after neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy (NACI) varies among patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). This study aimed to quantify intratumoral heterogeneity using habitat analysis and to develop a pretreatment model for predicting pCR. METHODS: In this retrospective multicenter study, 287 patients with NSCLC who received NACI followed by surgery were included. Patients were randomly divided into a training cohort (n = 147) and an internal validation cohort (n = 63), with an independent external test cohort (n = 77). K-means clustering was used to partition tumors into three habitat subregions based on entropy. Radiomics features were extracted from pretreatment CT images at the whole-tumor and habitat levels. Whole-tumor, habitat-based, and combined models were developed to predict pCR. Model performance was evaluated using area under the curve (AUC) analysis, and model interpretability was assessed using Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP). RESULTS: The habitat-based model showed acceptable predictive performance across the training, internal validation, and external test cohorts, with AUCs of 0.74, 0.71, and 0.67, respectively, and showed higher AUCs compared with the whole-tumor radiomics model, which achieved AUCs of 0.72, 0.68, and 0.65. The combined model achieved performance comparable to the habitat-based model. SHAP analysis suggested that, among the habitat-derived features, the most influential predictive features were primarily associated with the high-entropy habitat subregion. CONCLUSION: The habitat-based model shows potential performance for predicting pCR, and features from a high-entropy habitat subregion may provide complementary imaging information for preoperative assessment of treatment response.
